notes.title: UI & Notes Update
notes.notes:
We have improved the interface to make it clearer and easier to use.
 

 Additionally, we added new notes and clues that reveal more about the school's dark past, including details about the earthquake and the disappearance of the librarian.


Thank you for playing Earthquake Margarita School!

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
New Update Available!
[previewyoutube=vzWKxmWhqok;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to share with you the latest update of our game, Earthquake: Margarita School. We've worked hard to improve your experience.

What's New in the Update:

The issue with incorrect collisions has been resolved.
Visual glitches that appeared over distances have been eliminated.
These fixes allow for better immersion and enhance your ability to enjoy the graphical environment.

Performance Optimization

We've improved the game's performance by reducing loading times and fixing bugs that impacted fluidity.

Interaction Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where players could interact with objects that weren’t being aimed at. Now, interaction works only with objects you're directly pointing at.
General Audio Enhancements

Audio depth and quality have been improved overall.
New Horror Scenes and Details Not Included in Previous Versions

Immerse yourself in an even more terrifying experience with visual and auditory effects that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Story Enhancements

New clues and documents have been added to enrich the narrative.
Discover more about the dark past of Margarita School!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206465/1d3ae208d71d47a1c3edab93c625f446711f22cd.png

⚠️ Technical Changes:

Better handling of missing materials and assets to prevent loading errors.
Fixed an issue where animations remained active while the character was idle.

Download the Update Now

Don't miss this new and improved version that makes the game much more immersive and enjoyable! Download it now and continue exploring the mysteries of Margarita School.

Thank you for your support and for being part of our community. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to leave us a comment!
